summary: Continuation of the 个股 case studies (book pp.187-196). Finishes 鸿准 weekly M-top (two-wave measured-move downside, plus an 上飘旗形 cross-check), then 台泥 weekly (M-top + false breakout, two downside waves, then a 'large-wave' upside measured move and a fundamentals-based long-term buy at the downside target), 彩晶 daily (bottom-fishing a turnaround stock in step with the index: 破底翻 entry, convergence-bottom neckline add-on, 2-wave upside targets, unstable high-volume topping), 台化 weekly (one-year head-and-shoulders bottom projected for three equal waves, ended by a H&S top), and starts 元太 daily (main player's accumulation zone, first wave of distribution after a false breakout).

patterns.name_zh: M头 + 等幅跌幅满足（两波）
patterns.name_en: M top with equal-distance (measured-move) downside targets, two waves
patterns.structure: Two tops; take the midpoint of the line joining the two highs and the midpoint of the neckline vertically below it; distance = top_mid - neckline_mid. Short when price breaks the neckline (confirmed when it breaks the prior low on the neckline). After the first target, a rebound that fails and breaks the prior low starts wave 2.
patterns.entry: Weekly close with volume breaking the neckline (鸿准: short ~152.5 once the prior low 152.84 is broken; 台泥: ~37.5).
patterns.stop: Neckline reclaim (站回颈线): 鸿准 162 (risk ~6.2%), 台泥 39 (risk ~4%).

target.formula: target_1 = neckline_break - (top_mid - neckline_mid); target_2 = target_1 - same distance

confirmation: Volume on the neckline break (带量跌破颈线)
Second top shows a false breakout (假突破) = high-level sell signal (台泥)
Breaking the prior low on the neckline confirms the break (鸿准 152.84)
invalidation: Price reclaims the neckline (站回颈线)
A long enough consolidation can replace the second wave (time correction instead of price correction)

patterns.name_zh: 上飘旗形 跌幅满足
patterns.structure: Within a downtrend, a rising flag forms after the first-wave low; its high-to-low length projected down from the flag's rebound high gives a cross-check target.
patterns.entry: Flag breakdown (破线) — implied, the book only computes the target here.

target.worked_example: 鸿准: 132.98-73.94=59.04; 97.66-59.04=38.62, near the lower edge of the bottom zone 34.59~54.9.

confirmation: Target agrees with the M-top second-wave target / bottom zone

patterns.name_zh: 收敛底型（三角形收敛底部）+ 破底翻
patterns.structure: After a downside measured-move target is hit, price bases ~4 months in a converging range (彩晶 lows 3.15 / 3.75, neckline ~4.8). A 破底翻 below the rising support gives the early entry; a volume break of the neckline is the add-on.
patterns.entry: 破底翻 day with volume (彩晶 2009-03-11, buy ~4.25); a bigger-volume long red candle (量先价行, 2009-03-13, ~4.4); final add-on at the volume neckline breakout (2009-03-24, ~4.8).
patterns.stop: 破底翻 entry: break of 4 (~6%) or at worst the prior low 3.75; 3/13 add: short-term range low 4.07 before the volume (~7.5%); neckline add: 4.5 (falling back below the line), later raised to the 3/20 low 4.51.

target.formula: side_length = neckline - base_low; target_1 = neckline + side_length; target_2 = target_1 + side_length

confirmation: Index breaks its own neckline at the same time (随势而为)
Volume on the 破底翻 and neckline breakout
Bigger volume than anything in the base (9万+ vs max 5万+ lots) = 量先价行
invalidation: Pullback below the neckline after the breakout = false breakout (exit add-on, take profit on 破底翻 long)

patterns.name_zh: 头肩底 + 三波等幅涨幅满足
patterns.name_en: Head-and-shoulders bottom projected for up to three equal waves
patterns.structure: About one-year H&S bottom on the weekly chart (head low 25.45, neckline ~43.5). Distance head-to-neckline is added repeatedly from the breakout level; each further wave is computed only if price consolidates and then clears the prior high without a sell signal.
patterns.entry: Weekly long red candle breaking the neckline (台化 2009-08-15, buy ~44.9).

target.formula: d = neckline - head_low; T1 = breakout + d; T2 = T1 + d; T3 = T2 + d

confirmation: Re-crossing the prior high after a ~4-month consolidation triggers the wave-2 count
Consolidation without a sell signal allows the wave-3 count
invalidation: A sell signal at a target (here a H&S top with a heavy-volume long black candle breaking an ~8-month neckline ended the trend)

patterns.name_zh: 大波段涨幅满足（低点+前波涨幅）
patterns.name_en: Large-wave upside target (prior swing added to the higher low)
patterns.structure: After a V reversal from the low, the first up-swing (low to high) is added to the later higher low once price breaks the prior high with volume.
patterns.entry: Volume breakout of the prior high (台泥 2011-04-02 week) is when the count can be made; actual entry in the book was at the downside target on fundamentals.

patterns.name_zh: 主力进货区 / 颈线支撑区压低出货陷阱
patterns.name_en: Main-player accumulation zone and neckline-support distribution trap
patterns.structure: Long red candles with rolling volume after a neckline breakout mark the main player's accumulation zone (元太: 18 → ~25, cost estimated <20). After a false breakout with falling 库存余额 (main-player inventory), the main player distributes in waves from the high down to the neckline support.
patterns.entry: Short when the head is confirmed (翻黑破线, 元太 2011-11-16) — continues in u15e.
confirmation: 库存余额 falling steadily after the false breakout

rules.rule: An M-top break is confirmed when the prior low on the neckline is broken; short there, stop on reclaiming the neckline.
rules.quote_zh: 2007年12月15日当周带量跌破颈线，M头确立，空单进场，约可空在152.5元（跌破前低152.84元时确定破线），停损设162元附近站回颈线时，风险约6.2%

rules.rule: A two-wave decline completed by an up-sloping flag can also be measured with the flag's swing; it cross-checks the bottom zone.
rules.quote_zh: 上飘旗形完成的两波段跌势，也可以波段跌幅满足做计算。

rules.rule: After reaching the first downside target, a quick rebound that falls back below the prior low starts the second-wave count; a big head with a fast, steep fall usually has a second wave unless the consolidation lasts long enough (time instead of price).
rules.quote_zh: 弹后回跌再破前低，便可计算第二波跌幅满足，头部的规模够大且跌势快又急，通常表示都还会有第二波跌势（除非整理的时间够长，以时间修正争取空间的修正）。

rules.rule: A false breakout on the second top is a clear high-level sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 第二个头部已明显出现假突破的高档卖出信号

rules.rule: Fundamental filter for long-term buys at a downside target: blue-chip leader, 3+ years EPS > 1.5 with growth, adjusted price well below book value (>20).
rules.quote_zh: 当台泥达跌幅满足13.8元附近时，还原权息约在17元附近（最低14.15元），且当年净值仍高达逾20元，达跌幅满足附近，便具现股买进长期投资价值

rules.rule: Trade with the index (随势而为): when the index confirms a bottom breakout, aggressively buy individual stocks; deeply fallen low-price turnaround stocks rebound the most.
rules.quote_zh: 所谓随势而为，便是随大盘趋势作多空的选股顺势操作……通常跌深后的低价转机股大多弹幅可观，可做为多单布局标的。

rules.rule: Stock selection checklist for the 彩晶 long: target reached and ~4-month base; liquid (20-30k lots/day, margin allowed); 破底翻 with volume on the same day the index breaks out; price far below book value (an estimated safe period of at least a quarter).
rules.quote_zh: 彩晶当时减资后净值回到票面价值附近，股价远低于净值，预估至少有一季以上的安全期。

rules.rule: A stop 5-7% away from the post-破底翻 support counts as low risk; this justified the largest position weight.
rules.quote_zh: 当天收盘价4.25元，距破底翻后的支撑4元附近符合停损约5%~7%的低风险，即使破前低3.75元才停损也是相对风险有限，所以此股成为当时笔者积极布局多单时占资金最大比重的个股。

rules.rule: After a neckline breakout, the low two trading days before becomes raised support; breaking it is the stop for the add-on and the take-profit for the 破底翻 long (a pullback below the broken neckline is a false breakout).
rules.quote_zh: 跌破支撑为加码多单的停损点，也是破底翻买进的多单停利点（颈线突破再拉回跌破属假突破）

rules.rule: Convergence-bottom target: the side length equals the length after the neckline breakout.
rules.quote_zh: 收敛底部的边长=突破颈线后的等长。

rules.rule: A move that never breaks the 3-day low is extremely strong; turnaround stocks mostly run in one wave, so go straight to the second-wave target.
rules.quote_zh: 彩晶喷出一路不破3日低点属极强势，且转机股大多是一波到底的投机行情。因此直接计算第二波。

rules.rule: Volume larger than anything in the base leads price (量先价行) and justifies adding.
rules.quote_zh: 3月13日带更大的9万多张量长红，底型时的量最多5万多张，量先价行

rules.rule: Take profit where the target coincides with the prior decline's starting-high resistance; after heavy volume there is usually still a higher high; the first break of the 3-day low near the target is a warning.
rules.quote_zh: 涨幅满足8.1元附近也是前波起跌高点压力区，为多单获利调节时机，4月10日爆量也符合爆量后大多还有高点。

rules.rule: Repeated high-volume days that open high and close low are unstable volume and build a top; a volume no-gain black candle after volume contraction, followed by a line break, confirms the top.
rules.quote_zh: 高档震荡至5月期间三个带量都是开盘拉高走低，为高档不稳定量易做头的结构，6月8日为量缩后带量不涨且翻黑，隔日破线，头部确立为波段卖出信号

rules.rule: Turnaround-stock swings are traded only inside the estimated safe period; take profits at the first sign of an end, because uncertainty grows with time.
rules.quote_zh: 转机股一旦有结束迹象，便应见好就收，无需留恋，因为随着时间拉长，不确定性增加，风险也随之增加。

rules.rule: Each instrument usually offers one or two big turning-point swings a year; when one appears, set a stop and act boldly.
rules.quote_zh: 商品一年大多有一两次转折的大波段机会财，无论多头转折或空头转折，要胆大心细，一旦转折出现，设好停损，积极介入操作，便能以有限的风险获取难得一次的大波段利润。

rules.rule: Don't trade in and out short term; do your homework to catch swing timing and wait patiently.
rules.quote_zh: 股票不要经常进出短线操作，勤做功课才有实力掌握波段时机，以逸待劳。

rules.rule: Keep projecting further equal waves while consolidations produce no sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 强势整理约一个月便持续盘涨，盘涨的结构未出现卖出信号，续做第三波涨幅满足计算。

rules.rule: Hold while support holds and look for the targets; typical profit ladder 35% / 75% / 110% for waves 1/2/3.
rules.quote_zh: 支撑不破看满足，至少有第一波获利约35%，通常会在第二波涨幅满足附近，获利了结约75%，第三波则约110%。

rules.rule: Long red candles with rolling volume just after a neckline breakout mark the main player's accumulation zone and cost basis; falling 库存余额 after a false breakout means the main player is distributing.
rules.quote_zh: 接着连续长红滚量至25元附近都属主力进货区，主力平均成本粗估低于20元以下。……库存余额自此一路下降，显示主力长期炒高，开始自高档持续性压低出货

worked_examples.outcome: Hit both targets; short profit ~70% (first wave ~36%).

worked_examples.pattern: M头 + 假突破 → 跌幅满足 → 大波段涨幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Short profit ~63%; V reversal from 11.44, two-year rally to ~41.35 then topped; long-term long from the downside target ~200%.

worked_examples.pattern: 跌幅满足 → 收敛底 + 破底翻 → 涨幅满足 → 不稳定量盘头
worked_examples.outcome: Profit 68%-92% on the two-wave target; ~90% to over 100% in about a month from the 破底翻; top confirmed 2009-06-08; the stock later slid to 1.2.

worked_examples.pattern: 头肩底 → 三波涨幅满足 → 头肩顶
worked_examples.outcome: All three targets reached (2010-04, 2010-11, 2011-04); H&S top 2011-08-06 ended a ~2-year bull; profits ~35% / 75% / 110%.

worked_examples.pattern: 主力进货区 → 假突破 → 第一波出货 (continues in u15e)

quantifiable: M top: top_mid = mean(high1, high2); d = top_mid - neckline_mid; T1 = neckline_break - d; T2 = T1 - d; short when close < prior neckline low; stop when close > neckline.
Wave-2 trigger (downside): after T1 is reached, a rebound followed by a close below the wave-1 low.
H&S bottom N-wave projection: d = neckline - head_low; Tk = breakout + k*d; compute T(k+1) only if price clears the prior high after consolidation with no sell signal.
Convergence bottom: side = neckline - base_low; T1 = neckline + side; T2 = T1 + side.
Strength filter: no close below the lowest low of the prior 3 bars since breakout → skip to wave-2 target.
Raised support after breakout: low of the bar 2 trading days before the breakout bar.
Unstable top volume: >= 3 high-volume bars in a top zone where open is near the high and close is near the low.
Index-sync filter: take a long in a stock only when the index confirms its own bottom breakout in the same week.
Low-risk stop rule: stop distance 5-7% of entry is acceptable; size up when it holds.
ambiguities: 鸿准: neckline mid stated as 150 but the break level used is 159.5; the short was entered at 152.5 — the neckline is sloped, so which neckline value to project from is a judgement call.
台泥: wave-1 low 26.6 > target 26 is called 'near'; the final low 11.44 overshot target 13.8 by ~17% — tolerance for 'near the target' is not defined.
台泥 large-wave target adds the 11.44→32.19 swing to the higher low 20.6 — not the same as a pattern-based measured move; when to use it is not formalised.
彩晶 profit 68%-92% depends on the mix of entries; the exit was the 6/8 top signal, not the target itself.
台化 breakout level 43.25 vs neckline 43.5 — the book projects from the breakout price, not the neckline.
Fundamental filters (EPS, book value, safe period) are qualitative and not thresholded beyond the examples.
